title: Add forecast-frame rain diagnostics
purpose: 雨量判定・予測・全国候補抽出に関する変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body: Adds per-forecast-frame diagnostic details (time, status, intensity class, RGBA) only when interpretation is withheld. No rain classification, notification, or UI behavior changes.
head: b3aa42f4af3e71177c980c28d8fed6888449fe81
main_status: mainに祖先コミットとして存在（機能受入・本番は別）

files.patch:
diff --git a/app/api/rain/route.ts b/app/api/rain/route.ts
index f840728..48c1b39 100644
--- a/app/api/rain/route.ts
+++ b/app/api/rain/route.ts
@@ -42,6 +42,13 @@ export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
       observationFrames: observation.length,
       forecastFrames: forecast.length,
       expectedForecastFrames: forecastSeries.expectedFrames,
+      forecastDetails: forecast.map((frame) => ({
+        baseTime: frame.baseTime,
+        validTime: frame.validTime,
+        status: frame.status,
+        intensityClass: frame.intensityClass,
+        rgba: frame.rgba,
+      })),
     };
 
     if (diagnostic) {
